description: Vitya discovers a positive pregnancy test in the chest of drawers. However, he thinks that this is Masha’s test and does not even suspect that the Tasi test. Pasha is worried about the loss of the card and money, but Oksana is silent and does not want to admit that she took the card.  Ulya received a visa to America and is going to fly there with Yegor, but for a start she wants to talk before leaving with Sasha. Lily rents an apartment and incognito invites Bogdan to conduct a photoess. When the deception is revealed, Body cannot decide - to stay or leave. Vitya invites Masha to dinner to talk about their “child”, but he finds out that the child will be at Tasi.  Kyiv day and night - series, a format that is being implemented in Ukraine for the first time. It combines the drama of the series and life stories. If easier, this is a series that unfolds in real time with real people. Heroes are not actors, but ordinary guys who find themselves in the situations set by the script and show their natural, genuine emotions in them. There is a situation.
